title: AI Ethics: A Bibliometric Analysis, Critical Issues, and Key Gaps

bias_targets.methodology: Bibliometric keyword analysis using SCOPUS and VOSviewer to track the frequency of bias-related terms (e.g., 'algorithm bias', 'gender bias', 'cognitive bias', 'data bias') in AI ethics literature over 20 years, supplemented by a qualitative literature review summarizing external findings on justice and fairness.
